holes_found.description: Prose-flow observation on the ISS-3023 insertion. The new Newtonian-forcing sentence sits BEFORE "There is no far-side bulge because the far edge of the disc is 8× farther from the moon than the sub-lunar point." The 8×-farther argument is itself a Newtonian-forcing consequence (only inverse-cube-decay forcing produces a far-side attenuation that depends on distance ratio). A careful dome defender could read the paragraph as: "You just granted me the non-Newtonian escape, and then in the very next sentence assumed distance-cubed decay again. If I invoke non-Newtonian coupling to keep both bulges, the 8× distance ratio doesn’t automatically give you a null far-side bulge either." The current order is defensible (the escape sentence explicitly notes no such coupling has been published, so the geometric argument stands in the absence of a competing mechanism), but a tighter ordering would put the escape acknowledgment AFTER the geometric conclusion is complete.
holes_found.recommendation: Not blocking. Optional prose-flow tightening: swap the two sentences so the order reads "...at the equator (~14,000 km) it’s 0.6% of peak. There is no far-side bulge because the far edge of the disc is 8× farther from the moon than the sub-lunar point. This one-spike prediction assumes Newtonian (inverse-cube) tidal forcing — the same physics that gives the two-bulge pattern on the globe. The dome could in principle escape...". This completes the geometric case before granting the escape route. Defer unless someone is already touching this WIN.

kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Recognizing taxonomy is not prediction (data/wins.json:WIN-045.detail_evidence). Any model ingesting 24.84h produces M2 by division; the period is the input, not an output distinguishing dome from globe geometry. The discriminating outputs — amplitudes, phases, spatial patterns — are exactly where the geometric argument in the newly-patched detail_evidence exposes the dome (raw-text/08-live-power.txt lines 212-213: the dome monitor makes no attempt at any of these discriminating tests; it registers only period=period with 0.1% tolerance).
